coaching.headline: Out-majored 16-28 and won by 46 VP — a pure conversion win: five of six won fights cashed, and the last three fights took the base.
coaching.team: The mid-game was genuinely lost — 0-3 at 13.8, then 0-2s at our outer towers at 18.3 and 20.3, with the macro flagging fights taken while half the team never joined (16.6, 18.3, 20.3). They held Fangtooth at 15 and 21 and three Genesis spawns. The flip was conversion: we won 6 fights and cashed 5 — Fangtooth 26, Primal 32, Orb 38, Primal 39 — while their six wins cashed four; the late game was played five-strong around spawned objectives.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 31.8 and 37.1 picks at their inhibitor (2-0 each, the second opened a body down and still won) plus the 37.9 2-0 at our Orb — three fights in six minutes that banked Orb, Primal and the base.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Maco's line is a support masterclass by volume: 15 assists, 17 wards, on 3 deaths in 40 minutes. The support lane read flipped from theirs early to ours late — exactly when the team started cashing. One cut: the 21.2 solo catch by TwinBlast during the stretch when the team was already bleeding towers.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow carried the win condition: 17/5 with 24.2k objective damage, and the late picks (31.8, 37.1, 39.4) were the game. The two costs worth naming: caught at 9.4 rotating alone, and the 14-15 minute deaths sat inside the window that gave Fangtooth plus two towers. The Vanquisher spike at ~24 is when the film turns — before it, fewer fights; after it, all of them.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.
